verses.original: הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ יְהוָ֔ה אוֹדְךָ֣ כִּ֥י אָנַ֖פְתָּ בִּ֑י אַפְּךָ֖ יָשֹׁ֥ב וּֽתְנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm wə·’ā·mar·tā Yah·weh ’ō·wḏ·ḵā kî ’ā·nap̄·tā bî ’ap·pə·ḵā yā·šōḇ ū·ṯə·na·ḥă·mê·nî
verses.literal: In that day you will say O LORD I will praise You Although You were angry with me Your anger has turned away and You have comforted me

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה אֵ֧ל יְשׁוּעָתִ֛י אֶבְטַ֖ח וְלֹ֣א אֶפְחָ֑ד כִּֽי־ יָ֣הּ יְהוָ֔ה עָזִּ֤י וְזִמְרָת֙ וַֽיְהִי־ לִ֖י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’êl yə·šū·‘ā·ṯî ’eḇ·ṭaḥ wə·lō ’ep̄·ḥāḏ kî- yāh Yah·weh ‘āz·zî wə·zim·rāṯ way·hî- lî lî·šū·‘āh
verses.literal: Surely God is my salvation I will trust and not be afraid For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song and He also has become my salvation
With joy you will draw water from the springs of salvation

verses.original: הַה֗וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֞ם הוֹד֤וּ לַֽיהוָה֙ קִרְא֣וּ בִשְׁמ֔וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ עֲלִֽילֹתָ֑יו בָֽעַמִּ֖ים הַזְכִּ֕ירוּ כִּ֥י שְׁמֽוֹ׃ נִשְׂגָּ֖ב
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm wa·’ă·mar·tem hō·w·ḏū Yah·weh qir·’ū ḇiš·mōw hō·w·ḏî·‘ū ‘ă·lî·lō·ṯāw ḇā·‘am·mîm haz·kî·rū kî šə·mōw niś·gāḇ
verses.literal: and on that day you will say Give praise to the LORD proclaim His name Make His works {known} among the peoples declare that His name is exalted

verses.original: זַמְּר֣וּ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י עָשָׂ֑ה גֵא֖וּת זֹ֖את מְיֻדַּעַת בְּכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: zam·mə·rū Yah·weh kî ‘ā·śāh ḡê·’ūṯ zōṯ mə·yud·da·ʿaṯ bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Sing to the LORD for He has done glorious things Let this be known in all the earth

verses.original: צַהֲלִ֥י וָרֹ֖נִּי יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צִיּ֑וֹן כִּֽי־ גָד֥וֹל בְּקִרְבֵּ֖ךְ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: ṣa·hă·lî wā·rōn·nî yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ ṣî·yō·wn kî- ḡā·ḏō·wl bə·qir·bêḵ qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Cry out and sing O citizen of Zion for great among you [is] the Holy One of Israel
